description: MLI underwrite input: one row per unit (a tenant's demise), normalised to the PGIM 'TENANCY SCHEDULE (template)'. Consumed by the underwrite engine (Mode A normalise+classify, Mode B populate+return). Mirrors the engine field dictionary (C:\MLI/skills/mli-broker-schedule-normaliser/references/field_dictionary.md).
notes: Grain = one unit, NOT one deal (contrast inbound_uk.schema.json which is one row per deal). Money in GBP; areas in sq ft; rents quoted pa unless suffixed psf; dates are real calendar dates. 'priority' echoes the field dictionary: REQUIRED (underwrite wrong/blank without it), MATERIAL (moves the cashflow), OPTIONAL (metadata/safe default). 'flag' columns are judgement calls the engine must surface for analyst sign-off in Mode A, never auto-resolve.
engine_template_header: Header row 17 of the PGIM template; the engine resolves columns BY HEADER (v21 header-driven injector), so column position may shift without breaking this contract.

columns.name: Asset Name
columns.notes: Property the unit belongs to. Must match the deal/Asset Register exactly or the unit silently drops from totals. Aliases: Asset, Property, Scheme.

columns.name: Region
columns.notes: Display/grouping. Aliases: Asset Region, Location; derivable from postcode.

columns.name: Sector
columns.notes: Industrial / Trade / Office. Aliases: Type, Use, Sub-Type.

columns.name: Unit Number
columns.notes: Unique within the asset. Aliases: Unit, Demise, Suite.

columns.name: Tenant Name
columns.notes: 'Vacant'/blank implies Vacant @ Entry. Aliases: Tenant, Occupier, Lessee.

columns.name: Area GIA (sq ft)
columns.notes: Gross internal area, > 0. Aliases: GIA, Size (sq ft), SF, NIA. Validation: flag < 100 or > 1,000,000.

columns.name: Entry Yield (NIY)
columns.notes: Net initial yield at acquisition, decimal (0.06 = 6%). One value per asset is common. PRICING DECISION: confirm the acquisition yield; do NOT just take the schedule NIY. Validation 0.03-0.12.

columns.name: Exit Yield
columns.notes: Decimal. Biggest value driver; analyst's view. Validation 0.03-0.12.

columns.name: Lease Start
columns.notes: Real calendar date, never broker text. Aliases: Start, Commencement.

columns.name: Lease Expiry
columns.notes: Validation: Expiry > Start. Aliases: Expiry, Lease End, New Expiry.

columns.name: Break Date
columns.notes: Blank if none. Validation: Start < Break < Expiry. Aliases: Break, Break Option.

columns.name: Break Taken (1=Yes,0=No)
columns.notes: Whether the break is exercised. Derive if absent (break date approx lease end, or explicit vacate flag). Confirm exercise assumption.

columns.name: Rent Review / MTM Date
columns.notes: Next review/mark-to-market. If none, house convention (far-future or expiry). Validation: Start <= date <= Expiry.

columns.name: Event @ Expiry (Y=Renew / X=Vacate)
columns.notes: What happens at lease end. Y=renew at ERV, X=vacate+re-let. Vacate-at-expiry is a house view -> surface.

columns.name: Vacant @ Entry (Y/N)
columns.notes: Empty at acquisition? Derive Y if no tenant AND passing 0. If Y, passing should be ~0. Vacant valuation basis (capitalise guarantee/headline) is a per-deal confirm.

columns.name: Rent Review NEF
columns.notes: Net effective factor at review/re-let, e.g. 0.925. Default ~0.95 if absent (ask).

columns.name: ERV Growth to Lease Start (% pa)
columns.notes: Growth applied to ERV up to the (re-)letting date. Default = deal rental growth.

columns.name: Passing Rent (pa)
columns.notes: Contracted rent payable, 0 if vacant. GBP pa. Aliases: Rent (pa), Passing Rent, Contracted Rent. Validation: psf = rent/area should land ~3-40 for UK MLI.

columns.name: Guarantee Rent (pa)
columns.notes: Vendor rental guarantee / headline rent used to price a vacant-at-entry unit (capitalised as passing at entry; deducted via the entry vacancy deduction). Only meaningful when Vacant @ Entry = Y. v20/v21 column. Aliases: Headline Rent, Vendor Guarantee, Income Guarantee.

columns.name: ERV (pa)
columns.notes: Estimated rental value (market rent), GBP pa. Aliases: ERV, Market Rent, ERV - Next Lease. If only psf given, ERV = psf x area. Validation: usually ERV >= passing; flag if materially below.

columns.name: ERV (psf)
columns.notes: Used to derive ERV pa if absent. Aliases: ERV psf, Marketing Rent (psf).

columns.name: Rateable Value
columns.notes: GBP. Aliases: RV, Rateable Value.

columns.name: Business Rates (pa)
columns.notes: Void holding cost. GBP pa. Aliases: Business Rates, Rates Payable. If only RV given, rates approx RV x UBR multiplier (ask).

columns.name: Service Charge (pa)
columns.notes: Void holding cost. GBP pa. Aliases: Service Charge, SC.

columns.name: Assumed Void (mths)
columns.notes: Void period on re-letting; 0 if none. Aliases: Void, Letting Void, Total Void. Vacant-at-entry uses the engine entry-void default (I8) when blank.

columns.name: Assumed Rent Free (mths)
columns.notes: Incentive on re-letting. Aliases: RF, Rent Free, Incentive. Capture the value matching Event @ Expiry (new letting vs renewal).

columns.name: Re-letting Capex (psf)
columns.notes: Landlord capex on re-let, GBP psf; 0 if none. Aliases: Capex, Landlord Capex. Per-unit: blank means 0, never a blanket 25.

columns.name: 1954 Act (Y/N)
columns.notes: Security of tenure. Aliases: 1954 Act, LTA 1954.

columns.name: EPC Rating
columns.notes: Aliases: EPC, EPC Rating.

columns.name: Rent Review (Y/N)
columns.notes: Whether the lease has reviews. Aliases: Indexation Type (present -> Y).

columns.name: Term Certain (mths)
columns.notes: Term certain for re-let leases. House default 36-59 mths (ask). Aliases: Term Certain, Mark to Market (Years) x 12.

columns.name: Stepped / Indexed Rents
columns.notes: Contractual stepped/indexed uplifts as {amount_pa, date} pairs (Anniesland-style). Most deals have none. Surface for confirmation when present.

extraction_fields: ERV Growth to Lease Start (% pa)

flag_meanings.pricing: Acquisition/exit yield is the analyst's pricing call, not just the schedule NIY (see Cannon: 7.25% schedule vs 6.85% priced = ~2.4pt IRR).
flag_meanings.break: Break present -> is it exercised? Confirm.
flag_meanings.house_view: Vacate-at-expiry / event treatment is a house view -> confirm.
flag_meanings.vacant_basis: Vacant-at-entry valuation basis (capitalise guarantee/headline) -> confirm per deal.
flag_meanings.vendor_guarantee: Vendor rental guarantee treatment -> confirm; only prices vacant units.
